resources.string: Hides promoted posts and Google ads in timelines.
Adds Reseam Settings under Settings and privacy in the drawer.
Adds Reseam Settings to X\'s Settings and privacy.
Hides Grok stories, trends and chosen Explore tabs.
Sets X\'s feature switches to values you choose.
Hides the Grok tab and the Grok buttons across the app.
Hides the For You tab and the Add tab.
Stops swipes from switching Home tabs.
Hides the Live bar above Home and, if you choose, live rings on avatars.
Open mirror links in the app
Opens fixvx.com, vxtwitter.com and similar links in the app.
Opens a link\'s destination instead of going through t.co.
Opens a post link on the post instead of over the For You timeline.
Copies your login to the clipboard and lets you sign in by pasting one.
Adds a download button to posts with photos, GIFs or videos.
Downloads every video in its original file, without a watermark.
Offers to save all the media of a post when you save one.
Saves photos, videos and GIFs to a folder you choose.
Shows sensitive media without the blur or warning.
Reorders, hides and replaces the tabs of the navigation bar.
Hides chosen rows of the drawer, such as Premium, Money and Spaces.
Hides the prompts to turn on notifications.
Hides Premium offers, Get Verified prompts and the paywall at launch.
Hides the Boost and Promote prompts on your posts.
Unlocks Premium options the app checks itself, such as app icons and colors.
Stops the installed-apps report and turns off ad tracking.
Hides chosen profile tabs, such as Highlights and Likes.
Opens a profile\'s Media tab on Photos or Videos.
Removes tracking from the links you share, and can share posts through an embed-friendly host.
Brings back the Dim theme and Twitter branding, and adds accent colors.
Names the app Twitter with the bird icon in app info and notifications.
Sorts replies the way you choose.
Hides the new posts banner at the top of timelines.
Hides the counts on posts. The buttons keep working.
Hides Who to follow, Subscribe to and Communities to join.
Shows poll results before you vote.
Shows posts and profiles withheld in your country.
Lets you choose who translates posts, or turn translations off.
